title: Plasmo Voice Walkie-Talkie
description: Talk to other players on same frequency with no effort.
body:
![NeoForge](https://img.shields.io/badge/NeoForge-21.1.233-d8b62b?style=plastic&logo=curseforge&logoColor=white) ![Minecraft](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.21.1-3aa343?style=plastic&logo=minecraft&logoColor=white) ![Requires Plasmo Voice](https://img.shields.io/badge/Requires-Plasmo%20Voice-5865F2?style=plastic) [![Github Downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/SimpleFoxOfficial/pv-addon-walkietalkie/total?style=plastic&logo=github&label=GitHub&color=purple)](https://github.com/SimpleFoxOfficial/pv-addon-walkietalkie/releases) [![Latest Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/SimpleFoxOfficial/pv-addon-walkietalkie?style=plastic&logo=github&color=purple)](https://github.com/SimpleFoxOfficial/pv-addon-walkietalkie/releases)
--- Dependency: [Plasmo Voice](https://modrinth.com/mod/1bZhdhsH) ---

- **Easy to use** - craft the radio and use it on the go - **Numeric frequency channels** - tune in to talk privately with anyone on the same channel - **Cross-dimensional range** - stay in touch with players in other dimensions, not just nearby ones ## Coming Soon: - **Radio Stations** - can be placed like a block, supports variety of upgrades and modules - **More variants of Walkie-Talkie** - Analog, Digital and even creative walkie-talkie for debugging! - **Voice effect** (with a crunch in it) - **Megaphones, server configs** & much more!

- RMB Tap: Toggle the walkie-talkie - RMB Held: Speak in the walkie-talkie - Shift+RMB: Configure frequency and toggle walkie-talkie (is a menu)

Developed by [SimpleFoxOfficial](https://github.com/SimpleFoxOfficial) and **MrEri**, built on top of [Plasmo Voice](https://github.com/plasmoapp/plasmo-voice) by Apehum.
